query:
MATCH p = TRAIL (:player {id: $seed})-[:follow]->{1,3}(:player)
RETURN transform(nodes(p), n -> n.id) AS node_ids;
notes: Uses the already selected temporary graph and the supplied player/follow schema. TRAIL permits repeated nodes while excluding repeated edges; the directed quantifier covers 1 through 3 hops. nodes(p) with transform preserves path node order and business id values; RETURN omits DISTINCT to preserve duplicate id lists from parallel edges. Identifier helper found no keyword collisions in generated identifiers; $seed remains an external parameter. No database execution performed.
